name: Muñana (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Muñana (a tower on red above a bull on green).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 20 January 1998 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 59 of 10 March 1998); the flag is square of 1:1, crimson, with the municipal arms in its metals and tinctures at the centre.

features.role: Muñana arms — tower above a bull
